description: Registry of the MODIS-to-VIIRS transition experiments (single member, M36, snow-only DA). Scripts read this instead of hard-coding arms, dates, species or paths. Plan: docs/viirs_transition_plan.md. Verified 2026-11-21 against the runs' LDASsa_SPECIAL_inputs_ensupd.nml, the exeinp files and the output tree.

build.note: all five arms; VIIRS reader keeps Basic_QA 0 and 3; window-boundary double-assimilation fixes (8c778e4 VIIRS, 86afd34 + 8fbcc61 MODIS) are included

assim_step_note: LANDASSIM_DT not found as a setting in the run files; 3 h confirmed from ObsFcstAna: obs of one species at one step span 45 deg of longitude, and Terra and Aqua of a longitude band are in consecutive steps

obsfcstana_species_ids.note: inside ObsFcstAna files the species id is the local 1-4 index above; filter 'assimilated' with assim_flag and map via obsparam_descr

getinnov_note: getinnov is true for all four species in every segment of every arm; only assim differs

start_restart.note: all five arms start from the same restart

output_layout.obsfcstana: ana/ens_avg/Y<yyyy>/M<mm>/<exp_id>.ens_avg.ldas_ObsFcstAna.<yyyymmdd>_<hh>00z.nc4  (3-hourly; fields incl. species, assim_flag, tilenum, obs; ~250 files and ~160 MB per arm-month)
output_layout.catch_progn_incr: cat/ens0000/Y<yyyy>/M<mm>/<exp_id>.catch_progn_incr.<yyyymmdd>.nc4  (one file per day with 8 instantaneous 3-hourly steps at 00,03,...,21 UTC; ~34 MB/day; also a monthly file; single member so no ens_avg directory)

T_control.role: Terra only, no switch (MODIS control; continues T_to_J2's state at the switch)

TA_control.role: Terra+Aqua, no switch (MODIS control; continues TA_to_J1J2's state at the switch)

VIIRS_J2.description: Terra then J2: T_to_J2 over the whole record

VIIRS_J1J2.description: Terra+Aqua then J1+J2: TA_to_J1J2 over the whole record

C1.isolates: Terra vs J2 (sensor and overpass time)

C3.isolates: Terra vs Terra+Aqua, MODIS, six years

C4.isolates: J2 vs J1+J2, as a difference of differences: C4 in SY4-SY6 minus the same T-vs-TA difference in SY1-SY3 (no same-start J2-only arm; decided 2026-11-21)

known_issues: OL, T_to_J2 and TA_to_J1J2 read monitor-only MODIS (species 52/53, ids 1/2 in ObsFcstAna) from gmao_ops, which ends 2025-12-31: they have no MODIS obs in ObsFcstAna from 2026-01-01. T_control and TA_control read MODIS_obs/ (includes 2026). Take MODIS obs for 2026 from the controls.
MODIS_obs/ 2023-2025 are symlinks to the gmao_ops year directories; only 2026 (214 files) is new. gmao_ops lacks 4 days in 2025.
IMS is not independent of MODIS/VIIRS imagery; use it next to SNOTEL SWE and GHCN snow depth.
Overpass hours in the readers are fixed (Terra 10.5, Aqua/J1/J2 13.5 local); real Terra/Aqua crossing times may have drifted since about 2020-2022 (unverified).
constraints_for_scripts: Take arm dates, species and paths from this file; do not hard-code them.
The MODIS controls exist only from 2023-08-01; before that use T_to_J2 / TA_to_J1J2 (see continuous_series).
Within-day analysis needs the 3-hourly catch_progn_incr steps and ObsFcstAna; the monthly and tavg24 files lose it.
land_da file quota was ~91% on 2026-11-19: write compact summaries, do not copy or unpack the raw output.
